  "summary": "The requirement SFMC-REQ-053 specifies that authorized maintenance personnel must be able to install updated SFMC software during Standby mode. The SRS defines Standby mode as \"spacecraft is powered but not performing a mission\" (§1.3 Operational Modes). The requirement is clear, specific, and verifiable as it states who (authorized maintenance personnel), what (install updated SFMC software), and when (while in Standby mode). The SRS includes related requirements on software updates and security (e.g., SFMC-REQ-054 on verifying update integrity), supporting the context of this requirement. There is no ambiguity or undefined terminology in this requirement. No software allocation issues are identified since the requirement clearly involves software update capability, which is within the SFMC software scope as described in the SRS introduction (§1.1 Purpose). No applicable SWE linkage is justified by the supplied NPR passages, as none explicitly address software update installation during standby mode. The requirement aligns with NASA-HDBK-2203-5.09 guidance on clear, testable, and traceable software requirements (§3.7)."
